description: She wears a floor-length muted teal gown with a square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Gold cloud-like and geometric embroidery borders the neckline, shoulders, cuffs and open skirt front; larger circular motifs decorate the lower skirt. Small round brooches accent the shoulders. A gold plaque belt carries several chain ornaments ending in medallions and tassels. An ivory underdress shows through the center opening. A cream wrap with teal-and-gold cloud motifs rests around her arms and hangs at the sides. Small drop earrings and brown closed shoes with fine embroidery are visible.
